purpose: Stage 2 residual diagnostics and Stage 3 geometry ablations on the v2 development suite (development evidence only; not held-out test evidence).
physics_and_task: v1 frozen protocol configs/frozen/protocol.json (task config hash b9eac03d...) unless an entry overrides a runtime-safe controller field
policy_inference: deterministic actor mean, observation normalization frozen from the checkpoint

v1_checkpoints.source: release v1.0.0 assets checkpoints-<method>-seed<seed>.tar.gz, hashes checked against SHA256SUMS and archive_inventories.json

geometry_zero.note: full geometry (A+H+G, 1 cm bound), explicit zero residual

constant_offset_search.composition: constant_residual_m replaces the policy residual: p_candidate = p_nominal + clip(c, +-0.02 m), scored steps only, same 20 Hz control and target composition as the learned residual
constant_offset_search.zero_offset_reuse: x = 0 is not re-run; it reuses the base controller's zero-residual records (nominal, geometry_zero, geom_bound_0p015)
constant_offset_search.selection_rule: highest success rate on all 450 development cases; then fewer collision episodes; then smaller |x|; then ascending signed x
constant_offset_search.used_for: constants are selected on development only and frozen; never tuned on validation or final cases

definitions.H_off: never anchor; executed target is the (aligned) candidate
definitions.G_off: release follows the scheduled request (no contact gate, no release timeout)

geometry_ablation.other_parameters: fixed at v1 values (gain 1.0, sep_tol 0.01 m, max release wait 1.0 s)

trace_entries: nominal, geometry_zero, constant-selected entries, all learned-checkpoint entries, ablation entries
reported_metrics: per-condition success / drop / collision-episode / timeout / release-timeout / invalid-reset counts; policy-minus-zero and policy-minus-constant paired differences (seed x case bootstrap); signed residual means; executed-minus-candidate and workspace-clip magnitudes
